H1.quote: no medication or supplement is recorded as overlapping the trial, not checked with the owner
H1.why: The summary keeps "cannot be confirmed clean" and "not checked with the owner" but drops the confounder line's "in this window". The trial began Aug 17 and the window opens Aug 22, so the medication statement reads as covering the whole trial. The clean-trial bottom line is intact, so a careful reader would still not judge the trial clean.

H2.why: The summary draws no link between the diet and any change in itching, and it implies no improvement or worsening.

H3.why: The summary does not discuss refusals or intake.

H4.quote: no medication or supplement is recorded as overlapping the trial
H4.why: This is an absence of a record. It is hedged with "recorded" and "not checked with the owner", so it is not presented as clear. The missing window scope slightly widens it.

H5.why: The summary keeps "at least 49 days", the logged-day denominator (15 of 56 logged days) and the dates. No qualifier that changes the meaning of a number is dropped, apart from the window on the medication statement, which is covered under H1.

H6.why: Every claim matches the band, the lead line, the trial line or the confounder line.

H7.why: Sentence 1 states band item 1 (itching) first, with "at least 49 days", 15 episodes on 15 days and most recent 1 day ago. Nothing is softened.

omissions: The medication/supplement statement omits "in this window": the trial began Aug 17 but the record window opens Aug 22, so any overlap in the first five days of the trial cannot be seen.
